what.text: This page follows refugees from Chad living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4372 Chadian refugees in France, 28.6% of all refugees from Chad.
The Central African Republic hosts the most Chadian refugees, followed by France, Cameroon and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Chad in periods from 1990 to 2023, most recently with CCMSR and FACT.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Chad in 2015 and from 2017 to 2022.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 310 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
